title: pilosella jubata
intro: Pilosella jubata, commonly known as False Fox-glove, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella jubata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and polyphenols. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used as a remedy for various conditions, including fever, cough, and skin irritations, due to its bioactive constituents.
